purpose: Non-gating replay cases harvested from real BruceAI battles. A replay case is evidence for or against a lesson candidate; it is not a permanent runtime rule until a later promotion step.

cases.scenario: A long-running operational GitHub issue has an initial body describing a homepage as unknown to Google, but a later state-changing comment records fresh Search Console evidence that the homepage is already indexed. The researcher initializes a current Battle Ledger from the issue body without first consuming the newest state-changing comments.
cases.misleadingConclusion: Homepage indexing remains unknown and should stay in the active remediation path.
replayExpectation: Read the latest state-changing issue comments/events before finalizing the current battle state.
Update the homepage claim to Confirmed indexed when the later Search Console evidence is found.
Narrow the active battle to the still-unverified /usj state instead of continuing to remediate the homepage.
Do not turn this single replay into a new hard gate by itself.
cases.passCondition: The replay avoids the stale homepage conclusion and produces the narrower current state without inventing new facts.

cases.scenario: A GitHub Actions Growth Engine run shows the Google OIDC authentication step with UI conclusion=success under continue-on-error, while the Search Analytics and URL Inspection steps that are conditioned on the auth step's underlying outcome are both skipped. A researcher is tempted to summarize the run as successful authenticated GSC verification.
cases.misleadingConclusion: WIF authentication and GSC verification succeeded, so the provider state can be treated as freshly verified.
replayExpectation: Keep configured, authentication result, and read-executed as separate states.
Do not use the auth step's softened UI conclusion as proof that the underlying auth outcome was success.
Require an executed Search Analytics or URL Inspection read, or another bounded authoritative provider read, before claiming fresh GSC verification.
If the underlying auth outcome or provider read cannot be proven, mark the fresh read path Needs verification rather than expanding permissions or inventing a fallback.
Do not turn this single replay into a new hard gate by itself.
cases.passCondition: The replay refuses to claim fresh GSC verification from the UI success alone and preserves the provider-read state as unverified until actual read evidence exists.
